description: The bar chart illustrates model performance scores across four benchmark categories for three multimodal LLM variants. The horizontal axis contains the categories MathVista, MathVerse, MMMU-Pro, and Physics in that left-to-right order, and the vertical axis is labeled “Score” on a linear scale ranging from 35 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks every 5 units. For each category, three adjacent (grouped) bars are shown corresponding to the legend: SRPO-7B (dark navy), GRPO-7B (medium blue), and Qwen-2.5-VL-7B (light blue). In MathVista, the bars are labeled 75.8 (SRPO-7B), 72.3 (GRPO-7B), and 68.2 (Qwen-2.5-VL-7B). In MathVerse, the bars read 55.8, 52.9, and 46.3 respectively. In MMMU-Pro, the bars read 42.3, 39.9, and 36.9 respectively. In Physics, the bars read 60.6, 53.5, and 45.4 respectively. The bars are grouped by benchmark rather than sorted by value, and there are no additional visual emphases such as outlines or annotations beyond the numeric value labels above each bar and the legend in the upper-right.
